item.title: How AidKit Is Modernizing Aid Distribution
item.description: AidKit builds the infrastructure that helps governments and nonprofits get money into the hands of people who need it, faster and with less fraud. CEO Brittany talks through the business model, the AI fraud challenge, and what the next five years look like.

item.title: What Is Waste-to-Energy? Definition, Methods, and Impact
item.description: Waste-to-Energy converts municipal solid waste into electricity, heat, or fuel. Learn how WtE works, its role in the circular economy, and key impact considerations.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #311: Ethical Chocolate, Clean Energy AI, and Sustainable Farm Grants
item.description: Modernizing old industries: Tony’s Chocolonely’s ethical supply chain, AidKit’s $385M AI-driven aid, and Lupus Ventures’ new fund. Plus, $115M for Zanskar’s geothermal AI, $10M in agtech grants, and $250K opportunities from Morgan Stanley.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #312: Japan’s Impact Boom + Why Micro-Drones are the New Bees
item.description: Circular economy could cut 231M tonnes of $CO_2$ annually. 🌍 This week: Metafuels raises $24M for green flights, Japan hits record impact awareness, and micro-drones automate pollination. Plus, interviews with HOPE Hydration and Someone Somewhere.

item.title: B Corp Certification: What It Is, What It Costs, and Whether It's Worth It
item.description: B Corp certification costs more than most think, takes longer than expected, and isn't right for every company. Here's what the process actually involves, what you'll spend, and how to decide if it's worth it.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #313: AI "Talking" to Wildlife 🦒 + Building a Home in 30 Days
item.description: This week: Onx Homes builds sustainable houses in 30 days, Flox Intelligence talks to animals with AI, and Meta launches $50K wearable tech grants. Plus, $20M for zero-emissions fertilizer and the new "destruction ban" on unsold fashion.

item.title: Grove Collaborative: Business Case Study
item.description: Grove Collaborative is the world's first plastic-neutral retailer, how a DTC sustainable home products company raised $498M, went public, missed its flagship environmental goal, and rebuilt toward profitability without abandoning its mission.

item.title: Inside Impossible Metals and the Push for Responsible Deep-Sea Mining
item.description: Impossible Metals is building a fleet of autonomous underwater robots to harvest critical minerals from the ocean floor. CEO Oliver Gunasekara breaks down the tech, the business model, and why he thinks commercial deep sea mining is two to three years away.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #314: Scaling Circularity: eBay’s $300k and UNICEF’s Blockchain Grants
item.description: From the bottom of the ocean to the edge of space, impact is scaling. This week, we dive into Impossible Metals’ robotics, Tomorrow.io’s $175M satellite constellation, and the historic policy wins in California and Ethiopia that are redefining the social enterprise landscape.

item.title: How Givebutter Grew From a College Dorm to $9B in Donations
item.description: Givebutter CEO Max Friedman on 10 years of nonprofit fundraising tech: bootstrapping, COVID pivots, the We Are For Good acquisition, and what comes next.
